overlaps.rationale: A phone call is the act of contacting someone by phone; a cell phone is the device used to do so.
An email is a specific kind of message, but this candidate refers to the electronic mail format or service; the other is a general written or digital communication.
A voice note is a recorded audio message; the other candidate is a general written or digital communication.
A video call includes live video, while a call is phone contact generally; the candidates have distinct cues and translations.
A text message is a specific short message sent to a mobile phone; the other candidate refers to communication generally.
